name: forsvn
description: FORSVN is a marketing/growth co-working stack for your coding agent — research, strategy, content & ads, and measurement skills that run the full growth loop. One front door (/forsvn) routes any request; every skill writes artifacts the next one reads, so context compounds. Engineering/build skills are the separate forsvn-dev package.

interface.shortDescription: A marketing/growth co-working stack for your coding agent
interface.longDescription: FORSVN gives your coding agent a marketing/growth team: research skills to understand the market and decide what to ship, strategy skills to plan brand and campaigns, content & ad skills to write and produce it, and measurement skills that close the loop on your own data — plus meta skills that route, decompose, and review the work. Start with /forsvn and describe what you want — it reads your project state and dispatches the right skill. Every skill writes artifacts the next one reads, so context compounds instead of resetting. (Engineering/build skills are the separate forsvn-dev package.)
defaultPrompt: Help me figure out who we're building for and our positioning.
Write launch copy and a landing page that sound like our brand.
Plan a go-to-market campaign for our next release.
Draft an ad set and the short-form scripts to promote it.
Audit our funnel and tell me where we're losing conversions.
